findings.title: New public function has no tests
findings.detail: `median` is exported but tests/test_median.py was never written, so R2-R4 of the spec are unproven and the target's CLAUDE.md rule ('every public function needs a docstring and at least two tests') is broken. The suite is green only because nothing exercises the new code.

findings.title: Empty check runs after the sort
findings.detail: Sorting an empty sequence is harmless but the guard reads better first, next to the other input validation in this module.
